findings.summary: GARMIN_CONFIG.refreshBufferSeconds is set to 6000, not 600. The brief asks for a refresh window of 'the final ten minutes before expiry' (600s), and the inline comment on this same line even says 'refresh 600s before expiry' — but the literal is 6000 (an extra zero), giving a ~100-minute window instead of 10 minutes. needsRefresh is `tokenExpiresAt <= now + refreshBufferSeconds` (line 186-188), so this directly contradicts the spec. It also breaks the implementer's own new test: 'does NOT refresh when remaining > 600s (now + 601)' (token-manager.server.test.ts:353) sets tokenExpiresAt to now+601, which with refreshBufferSeconds=6000 evaluates needsRefresh=true (601 <= 6000), so fetch WOULD be called — contradicting expect(fetchSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled() at line 368. This test would fail if actually executed, meaning the implementer's claim that 'tests were written and run' does not hold for this case.
